# Discard persisted secondary sort when restoring a grouped view

The native RestoreSortInfo path clears secondary sorting for kGroupBySort, and getSortStatusFromView exposes only the primary for grouped views. New folders also need an initial sort-column entry when no saved columns exist. This adds native persistence detail to the existing grouped-sort rule; it does not mean a valid primary should be rejected because an old secondary is invalid.

Scope: mail/modules/DBViewWrapper.sys.mjs.
